label: General information
description: DC identity, documentation scope and responsible contacts.

sections.title: Document and data center
sections.description: Identify the document and the site it describes.

sections.title: Location
sections.description: Provide the physical location used by administrators and service engineers.

fields.label: Full address
fields.hint: Street, city, postal code and country.

fields.label: Site time zone
fields.hint: For example, Europe/Warsaw.

sections.title: Purpose and scope
sections.description: Describe what the DC supports and what this documentation covers.

fields.label: Role of the DC and supported services
Documentation scope
fields.hint: Locations, environments and systems covered by this document.

sections.title: Responsibility and contacts
sections.description: Record who owns the site and who to contact during normal work or an incident.

fields.label: Operations / NOC contact
fields.hint: Team or person, email, phone and availability.

fields.label: Incident contact and escalation
fields.hint: On-call contact, phone and escalation order.

fields.label: Facility support contact
fields.hint: Provider helpdesk, phone, email and customer / contract reference.

label: Physical layout
description: Draft of the physical layout chapter. DC Inventory already owns racks and U-level placement; these fields describe the surrounding layout and references.

sections.title: Rooms and rack layout
sections.description: Describe the site layout and point to its plans.

fields.label: Floor plans and drawing references
fields.hint: Document locations, drawing identifiers and revision dates.

fields.label: Room / hall arrangement
fields.hint: Areas, functions, boundaries, aisles and relevant access paths.

fields.label: Rack arrangement and naming
fields.hint: Rack rows, location convention and references to DC Inventory. Individual U placements remain in inventory.

fields.label: Physical capacity and constraints
fields.hint: Space, floor loading, transport clearances and expansion restrictions, if known.

label: Equipment
description: Draft of the equipment chapter. Device Visualization and DC Inventory remain the source for individual devices, ports, models and locations.

sections.title: Equipment scope and identification
sections.description: Record context and missing information without maintaining a second inventory.

fields.label: Equipment groups and roles
fields.hint: Core, access, security, compute, storage, management and other equipment covered.

fields.label: Identification and asset references
fields.hint: Hostname conventions, asset register references and where serial numbers are maintained.

fields.label: Management access conventions
fields.hint: Management networks, approved access methods and references to access procedures.

fields.label: Equipment information to verify
fields.hint: Missing models, serials, software, support or inventory assignments to complete later.

label: Connections
description: Draft of the physical connectivity chapter. Saved device-to-port connections remain in DC Inventory and Device Visualization.

sections.title: Cabling and physical connectivity
sections.description: Describe conventions, passive infrastructure and the context of existing connections.

fields.label: Cabling media and standards
fields.hint: Copper/fiber types, connector conventions, documented speeds and cable lengths where relevant.

fields.label: Cable identification
fields.hint: Cable labels and how endpoints are identified.

fields.label: Patch panels and structured cabling
fields.hint: Panel, socket and cross-connect naming; references to passive cabling records.

fields.label: Inter-rack / inter-room paths
fields.hint: Trays, risers, diverse paths and external cross-connect references.

label: Logical network
description: Draft of the logical network chapter. IPAM owns address records; Routing Map owns saved interfaces and routes.

sections.title: Logical network design
sections.description: Capture design intent and references rather than manually copying address and routing tables.

fields.label: Addressing and VLAN design
fields.hint: Network roles, allocation conventions and references to the relevant IPAM networks.

fields.label: Gateways and routing architecture
fields.hint: Routing boundaries, VRFs, dynamic/static routing design and Routing Map references.

fields.label: Security zones and segmentation
fields.hint: Zone purposes, traffic boundaries and references to the authoritative firewall manager/policy. Do not copy rulebases.

fields.label: Inter-DC connectivity
fields.hint: DC-to-DC links, logical separation, routing and dependencies.

label: External connectivity
description: Draft of the carrier and external-circuit chapter.

sections.title: Carriers and circuits
sections.description: Identify external services and how they enter the site.

fields.label: External connectivity
fields.hint: Carriers, circuit references, handoff locations, capacity and redundancy.

fields.label: Carrier and circuit references
fields.hint: Provider, service/circuit ID, service type, capacity and contract/SLA reference.

fields.label: Handoff and termination points
fields.hint: Meet-me room, rack/panel/port, medium and provider/customer responsibilities.

fields.label: External link redundancy
fields.hint: Independent paths/providers, failover design and shared dependencies.

label: Power
description: Draft of the electrical supply and equipment-power chapter.

sections.title: Power distribution and resilience
sections.description: Document known power arrangements and refer to electrical drawings and inventory.

fields.label: Power supply and resilience
fields.hint: A/B feeds, capacity, UPS, generator and known shared dependencies.

fields.label: Circuits, feeds and PDU references
fields.hint: A/B paths, circuit/PDU identifiers and references to electrical schematics.

fields.label: Device power-feed assignment
fields.hint: How device PSUs map to A/B feeds and where per-device outlet records are maintained.

fields.label: Power capacity and loading
fields.hint: Rated/usable capacity, measured load, spare capacity and measurement date.

label: Environment & security
description: Draft of the facility-environment and physical-security chapter.

sections.title: Environmental protection
sections.description: Document environmental controls and their operational references.

fields.label: Cooling and environmental conditions
fields.hint: Cooling arrangement, redundancy and temperature / humidity monitoring.

sections.title: Physical access and deliveries
sections.description: Explain how authorized personnel enter the facility and arrange work.

fields.label: Access request and entry procedure
fields.hint: Approvals, advance notice, visitor registration and escort requirements.

fields.label: Physical security
fields.hint: Access control, security desk and relevant operating procedures. Do not enter access codes.

label: Infrastructure services
description: Draft of the shared-service chapter. DHCP Generator remains the source for generated DHCP configuration.

sections.title: Infrastructure services
sections.description: Identify service locations, responsibilities and dependencies.

fields.label: DNS, DHCP and NTP
fields.hint: Server/service references, ownership, dependencies and DHCP Generator references where applicable.

fields.label: Authentication and administrative access
fields.hint: AAA, directory services, privileged access and relevant access-procedure references.

fields.label: Central logging and retention
fields.hint: Log destinations, responsible team and retention-policy references.

fields.label: Configuration backups
fields.hint: Backup system, scope, schedule, ownership and restore procedure references.

label: Resilience & recovery
description: Draft of the availability and disaster-recovery chapter.

sections.title: Availability and recovery
sections.description: Describe the intended failure behavior and how it is verified.

fields.label: External dependencies and single points of failure
High availability and failover
fields.hint: HA groups, redundant paths, failure domains and expected failover behavior.

fields.label: Backup and disaster recovery arrangements
fields.hint: Procedure references, backup ownership, recovery priorities and agreed RPO / RTO, if known.

fields.label: Recovery priorities and targets
fields.hint: Restoration order, service dependencies and agreed RPO/RTO where known.

fields.label: Failure scenarios and test references
fields.hint: Relevant failure scenarios, last verification date/results and unresolved gaps.

label: Maintenance
description: Draft of the support, maintenance and documentation-history chapter.

sections.title: Support and maintenance
sections.description: Keep references and operating arrangements here.

fields.label: Support, warranties and lifecycle
fields.hint: Support agreements, warranty locations, renewal/end-of-support dates and responsible team.

fields.label: Inspections and maintenance schedule
fields.hint: Recurring checks for facility and IT infrastructure; responsible teams and report references.

fields.label: Relevant changes and document updates
fields.hint: Change/ticket references, dates, affected areas and documentation update notes.

fields.label: Related documentation and links
fields.hint: Floor plans, contracts, runbooks, diagrams and existing documentation locations.
